title: excoecaria biglandulosa var. moritziana
intro: Excoecaria biglandulosa var. moritziana, commonly known as the Blind-your-eye plant or Poison-wood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. The health benefits of Excoecaria biglandulosa var. moritziana include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of microorganisms and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Excoecaria biglandulosa var. moritziana include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and cytotoxic activities.
